2842-4279-6248--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2842-4279-6248--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1263-2842-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-2842-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Blood Artist and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1432-1436-5261.easyPrerequisites:

Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.

Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

2023-4289-4770-4785.description:

Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

2586-3197-6797.description:

When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat

654-2239-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-2239-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Ardent Elementalist and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Ardent Elementalist and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-2239-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Ardent Elementalist and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

728-1228-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
728-1228-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2961-3175-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Cast Consult the Star Charts by paying {1}{U}, looking at the top seven cards of your library, putting Approach of the Second Sun into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Slick Imitator token's ability, copying the Slick Imitator spell.

1849-2457-2557-4289.description:

91-647-1656-4050-4170.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Necrotic Ooze undying until end of turn.
If Necrotic Ooze has any +1/+1 counters, activate it using Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a Treasure token.

Necrotic Ooze dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.

Activate Necrotic Ooze using Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Fain's fourth ability by paying {3}{B}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 6.
You may also use the infinite Inkling tokens to use Fain's first ability for infinite +1/+1 counters.
